leaderboard.style: e/acc one-liner lament on lab CEOs (Bro... / Et tu, Brute?), short regulatory-backfire warning on Elon, GOAT praise on Sacks
long anti-capture manifesto on Dario; short disappointed-fan ('bro please') on Elon; Lorenz-Sacks joke; MAGA threat one-liner on sama
image-only meme spam, no text, posted 1-3 times per mega-thread to harvest likes
insult + screenshot on Dario ('socially awkward dork'), 'No thanks' image on sama, thank-you one-liner on Sacks
data-flex IPO/quiet-period accusation on Dario, then leadership-praise one-liner on Sacks
short shock ('What the fuck' / 'What did 4.7 see?') plus image on Elon AI posts

patterns: Image-only replies (EvanKirstel, stutxo, Vuojolahti, HighyieldHarry) outrank text on the biggest CEO threads; first-100-char text is often empty.
First 15 minutes after parent is the like-harvest window for one-liners and screenshots; 4m (spnichol) and 11-14m (TheAIGeneralist, _yaksan) beat later essays on sama.
Dominant template is contrarian regulatory-capture / cartel / China-won't-slow, not genuine expertise; Jason, boneGPT, TheAIGeneralist, AkalStation all run that frame.

Reply length is bimodal: <20 chars (joke, image, 'GOAT', 'Best friends') vs 200-1500 char manifestos; mid-length (~1 sentence question) wins only when the author is named (TimSweeneyEpic, aphysicist, Sentdex).
Elon one-word/one-line posts ('Dario is right', '12 years ago') draw disappointed-fan one-liners; essay posts (Dario, Sacks) draw essay replies.
e/acc accounts (beffjezos) hit every lab-CEO thread within ~40m-3h with a short lament; they switch to praise when the parent is already anti-pace (Sacks).
Verbatim-quote-of-the-post is rare; screenshot-of-related-clip and 'you also said this' hypocrisy-flex (xLexemeX, robhughesyyc) is the Elon-thread substitute.

Genuine expertise is scarce in the like ranking: Tim Sweeney (evaluator politics), Emad (evaluator power-asymmetry), aphysicist (not METR), ChanaMessinger (will you commit). Those replies are short questions, not threads.
Late replies (4-7h) still chart if they carry a named account, an image, or a personal-stakes story (AkalStation cancer/rollback, MikeBenz screenshot).
swyx/simonw/openai/anthropic-official were not in the 24h mega-set; the day's AI-community gravity was a single Dario essay plus the sama/Elon/Sacks/Karpathy/Demis quote-cascade.
